physicalNotes: Radius 1.17 +/- 0.11 solar radii from Pidhorodetska et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1437 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..135P/abstract): 813,969 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.1 +/- 0.1 solar masses from Pidhorodetska et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1437 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..135P/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6008 +/- 113 K from Pidhorodetska et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1437 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..135P/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
